propertySets.name: Pset_ShipLockCommon
propertySets.definition: Properties common to the definition of all occurrences of IfcMarineFacility with the predefined type set to SHIPLOCK.

properties.name: CillLevelUpperHead
properties.definition: Height of the upper head cill level

properties.name: CillLevelLowerHead
properties.definition: Height of the lower head cill level

propertySets.name: Pset_ShiplockComplex
propertySets.definition: Properties common to the definition of occurrences of IfcMarineFacility with the predefined type set to SHIPLOCK, where the facility represents a complex of multiple shiplocks.

properties.name: LockGrade
properties.definition: Operational grading of the ship lock complex

properties.name: LockChamberLevels
properties.definition: Number of steps (chambers) in a lock line

propertySets.name: Pset_ShiplockDesignCriteria
propertySets.definition: Properties common to the definition of design criteria of all occurrences of IfcMarineFacility with the predefined type set to SHIPLOCK.

properties.name: MaximumUpstreamNavigableWaterLevel

properties.definition: Design minimum upstream water level for the lock complex

properties.name: MaximumDownstreamNavigableWaterLevel

properties.name: MinimumDownstreamNavigableWaterLevel
properties.definition: Design minimum downstream water level for the lock complex

properties.name: DownstreamMaintenanceWaterLevel
properties.definition: Design minimum upstream water level for the lock complex
